snippet.title: How the Top 1% Create Animated Instagram Carousels With AI
snippet.description:
⚡️Try Gamma's New Connectors ➡️ https://gam.link/TRISTEN

Animated Instagram carousels are getting more engagement than almost any other post right now, and AI can do most of the work for you. In this video I walk through my full workflow for making animated carousels with Gamma: using Gamma's AI research to write the cards, picking a template, editing every slide with the Gamma agent, exporting the cards as PNGs, animating each one in ChatGPT with the Gamma plugin, and posting the finished animated carousel to Instagram.

This video is sponsored by Gamma. I asked them to sponsor it because Gamma is what I actually use to build my carousels.

What you'll learn:
- How to make an Instagram carousel with AI in Gamma (Gamma 5 beta and the classic generator)
- How Gamma's Research mode digs up the content for each card so you don't have to
- Light vs Standard vs Max effort, and how credits work
- How to pick a carousel template or upload your own branded template
- How Gamma asks clarifying questions and shows an outline before it builds anything
- How to edit text, images, layouts, colors, and card style
- How to switch AI image models (GPT Image 2, Nano Banana Pro, and more)
- How to use Edit with Agent to change any card with a simple prompt, and revert anytime
- How to export Gamma cards as PNG images
- How to animate every carousel slide with ChatGPT and the Gamma plugin
- How to post an animated carousel on Instagram
